hints.title: Transit Line Network
hints.text: Model bus routes as interconnected nodes in a transit network where changing lines costs one transfer.

hints.title: Stop to Route Inverted Index
hints.text: Map each bus stop to the set of routes passing through it to quickly identify transfers.

hints.title: Route-Level Level Order Search
hints.text: Explore line-by-line rather than stop-by-stop. Track visited routes and visited stops to find the minimum buses needed to reach target.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: BFS traversing bus routes using inverted stop-to-route lookup.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph search directly over all stops creates up to 10^5 nodes with dense transfer cliques.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inverted map stores every (stop, route) incident edge once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model routes as graph vertices to minimize BFS branching factor.
